Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that the mother’s country of origin was Russia and later conflated two different “Pauline of Württemberg” figures. Prince Nikolaus Wilhelm’s mother is Pauline Friederike Marie of Württemberg (1810–1856), a Württemberg (German) princess born in Stuttgart, not Pauline Therese of Württemberg (1800–1873) who was born in Riga, Russian Empire. This misidentification, driven by flawed heuristics (e.g., treating a national TLD as corroboration) and ignoring the Wiesbaden city lexicon result that pointed to Pauline Friederike Marie, led the process down the wrong path.
